# Model Artifacts

## Included legacy demo artifacts

- `legacy_emotion_bilstm_model.keras`
- `legacy_tokenizer_config.json`
- `legacy_label_mapping.json`
- `legacy_model_metadata.json`

These are the exact supplied artifacts, renamed to make their status unambiguous. The checkpoint is a **BiLSTM without attention**, trained after filtering the 10-row sample down to seven rows and three classes. It exists only to demonstrate model loading in the Streamlit interface.

## Files generated by the upgraded training pipeline

Running `python scripts/train_model.py --data <licensed-full-dataset.csv>` creates:

- `emotion_bilstm_attention_model.keras`
- `best_emotion_bilstm_attention_model.keras`
- `tokenizer.json`
- `label_mapping.json`
- `model_metadata.json`

The Streamlit app automatically prefers this attention-model artifact set when available.

For large model files, use Git LFS or an external model registry rather than ordinary Git blobs.
